summary: St. Joe NF crow's-nest tree and tent camp from the 1930s; abandoned in the 1940s; a 2022 visit found a collapsed platform, planks and phone wire.

facts.status_note: Platform collapsed by 2022; planks and phone wire still on the trees

visit.trail_note: Idaho Fire Lookouts files it as hike-in; Trail 26 climbs about 2 miles to it (University of Idaho guide); a forest service road was blocked by a 4-foot snow berm in early April 2022

events.note: Crow's-nest tree and tent camp; sources give only 'the 1930s'
Early April 2022 visit: platform collapsed, planks and phone wire still on the trees

evidence.supports: likely manned only during high fire danger
evidence.quote: It was likely only manned during episodes of high fire danger.

evidence.supports: platform collapsed, planks still on one tree
evidence.quote: Currently the platform is collapsed but several planks are still secured to one tree with large nails.

evidence.supports: phone wire still attached to the trees
evidence.quote: The phone lines were a single #9 galvanized wire and are still attached to the trees at the platform

evidence.supports: crow's nest still there, undated; abandoned 1940s

evidence.quote: It was last staffed almost 80 years ago
So on an early April morning, Cat and I set out to find our first crow’s nest.
we could eventually make out pieces of a platform that had once been strung up between two trees

evidence.supports: forest road blocked by snow berm
evidence.quote: We had planned on driving up a forest service road, but that was blocked in by a 4ft snow berm.
we parked on the side of the road and began our journey
Trail 26 goes to Three Tree Butte after climbing for 2 miles.

corrections.why: A 2022 visit found a collapsed platform with planks and phone wire still on the trees, so the site is not gone. Ruins is the proposed label; an editor should confirm.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The brief flagged idahofirelookouts.com's status as read from a short summary. The full page says Hike-In Abandoned, with abandonment in the 1940s and remains found in 2022.

sources.title: Three Tree Butte Fire Lookout Tower

notes_for_editor: Dates are decades only (1930s, 1940s). The 2022 visit is the only physical evidence, and it is one party's search. Elevation: idahofirelookouts.com says 3600 ft (about 1,097 m), while the brief says 1111.3 m (about 3,646 ft); not corrected. The weebly page's 1930s camp credit was not used because its text was not confirmed. No free-licence photos found.
